notes.title: UPDATE: Steam Playtest Now Closed
notes.content:
UPDATE - 2nd May: Closed now, thanks for trying it and sending feedback!

--------

Hey everyone,

An open Steam Playtest for Guard Break is now live. This includes the same content planned for the upcoming demo- roughly the first hour of the game.

I'm using this playtest period to get initial impressions on things like pacing, combat mechanics, and overall feel. If you'd like to try it early and share your thoughts, I'd really appreciate it.


 Click "Request Access" on the store page to join automatically
 Playtest length is TBD- likely a couple of weeks at least
 Feedback welcome via Discord or the in-game form link
 
Thanks for the support!
